verdict.rationale: Built-in physics (rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts) is a fair question for a game engine like Unity, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions physics, rigid bodies, colliders or raycasting. The pack covers only rendering, multiplayer, CLI, builds, MCP and pricing, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box
